name: Tung Tung Tung Sahur Brainrot Memes
what_it_is: Videos built around the Italian brainrot character Tung Tung Tung Sahur, a wooden log figure with a carved face. Clips include AI-generated skits (with Ronaldo, Trump, Shamo), a light-up skateboard toy demo, live-wallpaper tutorials, and CapCut "Summer Bummer" duo-dance templates pairing Sahur with Pickle Sahur.

what_we_now_know: EU retailers are running physical Tung Tung Tung Sahur merchandise — Danish supermarket plush toys at 45 kr., Estonian 1,354-piece brick-building kits, and Italian back-to-school backpacks — always positioned as one item in an 'Italian brainrot' character line-up rather than as a character in his own right.
